text:
alex: Hey folks — tiny idea: mini desk-stage today at 3pm? I brought my uke :ukulele: for a 60s set. Who's in?
maria: Ooh yes! I can bring terrible kazoo backup. :laughing: sign me up for 30s harmonies.
jordan: 60s or bust. will bring a kazoo or maybe just rhythm claps. :clap:
sam: Not musical but can provide moral support and snacks. Also I vote for a confetti-free zone.
taylor: lol confetti-free but with tasteful rave lights (aka my phone flashlight). very solemn. :rofl:
alex: OK signups so far:
1) alex — small uke set (60s)
2) maria — kazoo harmonies (30s)
3) jordan — claps + backbeat (60s)
4) sam — snacks + vibes
maria: Should we put a 1-song-per-person rule? Also is the small conference room free at 3?
ops-bot: Room check: #micro-conf-room free 14:45–15:30. (book with `/book micro-conf-room 15:00 00:30`)
sam: Great — I'll book it. Also who wants lemon cookies? :cookie: (I brought an extra batch)
taylor: Me. Also will there be applause metrics? I can do a scientific clapping meter.
jordan: Applause meter = number of :thumbsup: reactions in 30s after set. Fair and brutal.
maria: Adding a quick rule: no surprise office renditions of 'Bohemian Rhapsody' unless pre-cleared by security.
alex: Agreed. Also pre-cleared song list: short, sweet, and office-friendly.
sam: booked `/book micro-conf-room 15:00 00:30` — confirmed. see you all there. :calendar:
taylor: Bringing spare hair ties and a roll of gaffer tape (for emergency ukulele-peacekeeping).
alex: Love this. tiny-stage MVP today. If anyone wants to perform but is shy, we do 'one-liner open mic' instead — one joke, one line, no encore.
maria: I will prepare one very questionable dad joke.
jordan: i'll warm up my palms. see you at 3! :wave:
sam: Cookies locked in my desk. First-come-first-eat.
ops-bot: Reminder set: micro-conf-room event "Tiny Desk Hour" at 15:00 (30m).
alex: (thread end) — see you in 45m. Bring vibes, not confetti. :sunglasses:
